contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty and the statement does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001–THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001. Live literature confirms the jet/principal-parts rank-2 evaluation on a smooth curve (Vakil jet notes: J^1 L ~ L⊗(O⊕Ω), rank 2; Wikipedia/Fulton Ex. 2.5.6 / SGA 6 principal parts; Androma: j^1 target is H^0(L⊗O/I_x^2)), so dim ker j_p^1 >= h^0(L)-2 and h^0>=3 forces a section vanishing to order >=2, hence a nonreduced member of |L|. Complementary to corroborated packet FND-0083 (χ(L)=1 ⇒ Sym^6 Abel–Jacobi fibre nonempty, not that reduced-support/Conf_6 is nonempty on every fibre) and compatible with FND-0005’s note that nonreduced members are a proper closed condition in |L|: the jet argument supplies nonreduced witnesses but is not a reduced-member existence proof. Do not merge into FND-0083/FND-0087/FND-0064/FND-0103 (related themes, distinct mechanism). Promote from candidate/adversarial_review to corroborated primary_source on this independent verification.

scope.campaign_application: Applies on C66-GEO-H0 strata with fiberwise h^0(L)>=3 (packet: h^0(L) in {1,2,3,4}, with >=3 when h^0(M)>=2; never 5 by FND-0103).
caveats: Requires smoothness at p so dim O/m^2=2; fails as stated at singular points.
Linear-algebra kernel bound holds in any characteristic.
'Boundary divisor witness' means the nonreduced / non-reduced-support locus inside |L|, not a moduli boundary divisor of Mbar_{g,n}.
scope.does_not_prove: Existence of a reduced-support member of |L|, nonemptiness of the reduced-support open, or a Conf_6 point on every geometric fibre.
scope.mathematical_scope: On any smooth curve over a field, for any line bundle L with h^0(L)=k>=3 and any smooth closed point p with residue field the base field (or after geometric base change), the first-jet / principal-parts evaluation j_p^1:H^0(L)->L\otimes O_p/m_p^2 has 2-dimensional target, hence dim ker>=k-2>=1; nonzero kernel sections vanish to order >=2 at p and give members of |L| nonreduced at p. The same bound holds for incomplete series V with dim V>=3.
scope.proves: Existence of a nonreduced member of |L| (or |V|) through each smooth point p; a witness in the non-reduced-support locus of the relative linear system.
